items.html: And through the five Chassadim of the drop of Aba, they are all sweetened, and with them they are completed to the 325 sparks mentioned in the Idra, Torah portion Naso, page 132b: “Rabbi Chizkiyah said, I was watching, etc., it shone and rose to 325, it became pregnant, etc.” Then the Nukva is called “a maiden with a Hey,” matching the number 325.
